annotations.title: Add comments after publish to a post

description:
[PUBLISHES to social accounts · `publish` scope] Schedules comments on a post, sent once after it is live on that platform and its tokens resolve ({{postUrl}}, {{parentPostUrl:<post id>}}, {{youtubeUrl:<post id>}}), optionally at sendAt. Confirm with the user first. Needs the `publish` scope (or admin) on the Agency plan or higher.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/posts/{id}/comments.)

accountId.description: Default: the account the post went out through on that platform.

name: add_post_comments
title: Add comments after publish to a post
